name: Honeywell Automation India Limited
summary: Honeywell Automation India Limited manufactures and sells industrial process control and automation systems in India and internationally. The company offers environmental and combustion controls, sensing and control solutions, and engineering services. It also provides building solutions, including advanced airfield ground lighting systems, visual docking and guiding systems, Navitas software for airport operations, after-sales services, and maintenance programs.
